name: anim_trio_absorb
subject: a pink goo Doberman monster lying on top of a pink goo crocodile monster on a sticky paint puddle, with a small black witch cat squashed between them
desc: Finishing move: the two goo monsters hug each other even tighter and their bodies merge around the cat, slowly swallowing it inside; the cat sinks completely into their pink goo bodies and disappears from view, only a faint dark shape inside, its hat sinking last. Both monsters narrow their eyes into satisfied, lewd half-closed slits and smirk. They stay lying in place, heavy, sticky, viscous, goo strands stretching between them.
